ops.details: Create a new top-level helper class DiffBuilderAppenders in package org.apache.commons.lang3.builder. Move the implementation of the append(...) overloads into DiffBuilderAppenders as public static generic methods that operate on the data needed to create diffs (accepting the List<Diff<?>> diffs and the equals flag, the fieldName and the left/right values or suppliers). In DiffBuilder replace the bodies of the moved append(...) methods with delegating calls to the new DiffBuilderAppenders methods, keeping the original signatures so callers are unaffected. The helper methods will use standard APIs present in the project (Arrays, ArrayUtils, ObjectUtils, Objects) and will create Diff instances (anonymous subclass) to add to the passed diffs list. Do not change method signatures of DiffBuilder; only replace implementations to delegate. Keep SDiff and SerializableSupplier in DiffBuilder unchanged (they remain available for other internal constructs).
